Strong momentum and percussion give high energy and danceability; darker timbral center suggests lower valence. Moderately intense and moderately usable for social settings.

Moderate tempo (~108 BPM) with relatively high mean onset strength and rms (0.126) and bright spectral centroid — punchy, groove-forward track. Good for dancing but not maximal peak energy; neutral-to-slightly-dark mood. Fairly suitable for mingling when not foregrounded.

Mid tempo (~108 BPM) with low rms and low onset rate — sonically soft and restrained. Low perceived drive and sparse transients make it low-energy and easy to coexist with conversation. Neutral valence and low intensity.

Upbeat tempo (~117 BPM) with very high rms mean/max and large dynamic range — loud, forceful and dramatic. Strong presence and punch create very high energy and intensity; less appropriate as background for socializing. Timbre is darker/serious (lower valence).

Laid-back tempo (~96 BPM) with moderate rms and solid onset rate — mid-energy, groovy track. Bright spectral content and steady transient activity support comfortable dancing and social play. Moderate intensity and neutral valence.

Near-100 BPM, comparatively high rms and bright spectral centroid — lively and upbeat. Clear transient content and brightness yield good danceability and a positive/bright feel. Energetic without being overwhelming; works in social contexts if volume is controlled.

Moderate tempo (~117 BPM) but very low rms, very low onset rate and narrow dynamic range — sparse, low-drive piece. Quiet and unobtrusive, highly suitable as background for conversation; low intensity and subdued mood.

Slower (~92 BPM) with low rms and modest transient activity. More active than the other 'tmp' but still restrained overall — gentle groove, pleasant background presence, higher social compatibility than a dance-floor track.

Fast tempo (~152 BPM) with mid-low rms but consistent onset activity — energetic electronic track with brisk momentum. Good for dancing; somewhat bright/optimistic valence. Noticeable presence so moderately intrusive for socializing.

Moderate-fast tempo (~123 BPM), high mean onset strength and very high transient peaks (onsetStrengthP95 7.44) with solid rms — punchy, driving electronic track. Strong dance-floor appeal and high intensity; darker/edgier tone reduces valence and makes it less suitable as passive background.
Ambient track with moderate tempo (≈123 BPM), low–moderate loudness (rms mean 0.15) and gentle onset activity — overall subdued, calm, and mellow rather than driving or bright.
Ambient, lower RMS (0.115) and modest onsets; sparse and introspective with little rhythmic push — well suited to background/social listening, emotionally darker/neutral.
Jungle/’phonk’ edit with pronounced transient activity (onset rate 5.22), high spectral brightness and zero-crossing — rhythm-forward and danceable, gritty/darker mood, moderately intense.
Faster, punchy cut (≈136 BPM) with strong transients and elevated RMS — high momentum and drive, clearly club/beat-forward, fairly forceful and commanding.
Mid/high spectral content and moderate loudness with noticeable onsets — energetic and aggressive-leaning; rhythmic enough to move to but darker in emotional tone.
Long electronic piece with higher RMS (0.245) but moderate onset activity — warm, pleasant daytime vibe (higher valence), comfortable for background/social settings, not overly aggressive.
Very sparse, low spectral centroid and extremely low onset rate — calm, minimal, highly unobtrusive and ideal for quiet social spaces or reflection; low intensity and danceability.
Mid-tempo track (≈103 BPM) with solid onset strength and mid/high spectral content — moderately driving and present without being overwhelmingly aggressive; versatile for casual social contexts.
Spacey/electronic texture with low RMS and moderate spectral brightness; steady but not urgent — pleasant background material, mildly danceable but suited to social listening.

Highly active electronic cut: high onset rate (6.68), elevated RMS and spectral centroid — strong drive and groove, very dance-floor oriented and commanding; less suitable as low-attention background music.

Mid-tempo (≈108 BPM) electronic track with moderate RMS and onset activity; perceptible drive and steady beat but not hyper-aggressive. Danceable groove but somewhat restrained/ambient in brightness; suits casual social settings.

Faster (≈123 BPM) electronic with higher RMS, strong onset rate and wide spectrum — energetic club-style feel. Clear rhythmic thrust and high danceability; fairly commanding and attention-grabbing, less suited for background socializing.
Around 99 BPM with relatively high RMS and onsets — driven, punchy electronic track. Good groove for movement without being maximalist; moderately intense and workable in mixed social/dance contexts.

album: It's Really Pretty Simple After All

llm.description: Moderate tempo (~108 BPM) with relatively high RMS and warm spectral content. Pleasant, mid-energy feel that is unobtrusive and suitable for conversational settings; moderate intensity.
Lower RMS, mellow spectral centroid and moderate onsets at ~99 BPM — subdued and atmospheric. Not strongly danceable; very suitable for relaxed social environments, low intensity.
Moderate tempo (~112 BPM) with low RMS and modest dynamics; darker spectral profile. Calm, understated track that supports conversation rather than commanding attention.
Longer, low-RMS electronic piece with moderate onsets and mid spectral centroid. Subtle, minimal energy and low intensity — easygoing background music, high social compatibility.

Slower BPM (~81) but high RMS, bright spectral rolloff and strong presence — punchy techno vibe. Very forceful and intense despite lower tempo; good for movement or focused listening, less for quiet mingling.
Low RMS, low spectral centroid and narrow bandwidth; sparse, quiet texture despite mid BPM. Gentle and unobtrusive — excellent for social backgrounds, not dance-forward or intense.

Mid-tempo (≈112 BPM) electronic remix with notable onset density and mid RMS; driving percussion and spectral brightness give it elevated energy and danceability, moderately positive/bright, moderately commanding.

Slower (~99 BPM) track with modest loudness and onsets; darker tonal centroid and slightly aggressive RMS profile suggest moody, mid-energy material that leans intense/edgy rather than upbeat or social.

Up-tempo (~129 BPM) electronic with relatively high RMS and clear rhythmic drive; steady groove and spectral brightness support strong danceability and elevated energy, fairly playful/positive but still forceful.

Similar tempo (~129 BPM) electronic piece with higher onset strength and punchy RMS — energetic and rhythm-forward, good for dancing, moderately intense and more track-focused than background-friendly.

Mid-tempo (~123 BPM) electronic with solid RMS and moderate dynamics; steady groove and moderate spectral weight make it reasonably danceable and social, with a slightly brooding tone.
Moderate tempo (~92 BPM) track with relatively high RMS but low onset strength; more laid-back, less percussive — suitable as background social music rather than peak dance-floor material.
Very fast (~152 BPM) piece with high peak RMS and wide spectral content; forceful and aggressive sonic profile with strong energy and intensity, more attention-demanding than social/background.
Very fast (~172 BPM) long track with high RMS peaks and strong onset P95 — extremely energetic and commanding, intense and driving; high dance potential but not well-suited for relaxed socializing.

Abstract, mid-tempo (~112 BPM) with low RMS and low dynamic range — restrained, ambient textures and sparse transients. Works well as background/social music rather than an energetic or intense track.

Slower (~96 BPM) but spectrally bright with high peaks (high RMS P95/Max), higher onset rate and wide dynamic range — perceptibly forceful and dramatic. Moderately danceable but more commanding and attention-grabbing than background music.

Up-tempo (~117 BPM) with strong onset activity (high onset P95 and rate) and moderate RMS — energetic and rhythmic with clear transients. Suits dancing or active listening; somewhat intense and less suited as purely conversational background.
Mid-tempo (~108 BPM) with relatively warm RMS and moderate spectral content. Feels lively but not aggressive — balanced for light dancing and social settings, neither overly bright nor very dark.
Laid-back (~89 BPM) with higher mean RMS but low onset rate and moderate dynamic range — mellow and unobtrusive. Pleasant as background/social music; not highly dance-inducing or intense.
